editorial:
Imagine yourself escaping to a beautiful, sunny island for a vacation, only to get caught up in a deadly mystery. You follow Detective Cassady Cruz, who is just trying to relax until she meets Travis King. He is a smooth expat who quickly sweeps her off her feet. Things get messy fast when Travis's ex-girlfriend turns up dead, and he becomes the main suspect. Since Cassady is a pro at solving crimes and believes he is innocent, she starts digging into the island's secrets. The vibe is a mix of a romantic getaway and a tense crime drama that keeps you guessing who to trust.

You will notice that the chemistry between the leads makes the story feel real, even when the plot gets wild. The pacing moves quickly, though some of the clues feel a bit too easy to find. If you love a good whodunit with a tropical backdrop, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the killer was actually trying to frame Travis to hide their own dark secrets. After a tense standoff, Cassady uses her detective skills to find the real evidence that clears Travis's name. The real murderer is finally caught and arrested just in time. In the end, Cassady and Travis survive the trap, and they decide to stay together, proving that their romance was stronger than the lies surrounding them.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves beachy mysteries and romantic suspense.
